description: This PHP source file defines the TreasuryBill class within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods for calculating financial metrics related to Treasury bills, such as yield, price, and bond-equivalent yield, utilizing various validation and date calculation functions.

classes.name: TreasuryBill
classes.description: Provides calculations related to Treasury bills including yield, price, and bond-equivalent yield.

methods.name: bondEquivalentYield
methods.description: Calculates the bond-equivalent yield for a Treasury bill given settlement date, maturity date, and discount rate.

methods.name: price
methods.description: Calculates the price per $100 face value for a Treasury bill based on settlement date, maturity date, and discount rate.

methods.name: yield
methods.description: Calculates the yield for a Treasury bill given settlement date, maturity date, and price.
